summary: A protected Supabase Management API validation workflow exists, but it has not yet executed for the final deployed main SHA. Google OAuth provider configuration therefore remains unverified for enterprise release.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
productionGate: blocked until protected Google OAuth provider validation passes for the exact deployed main SHA
completionRule: Run the Google OAuth Provider Proof workflow for the exact deployed main SHA with SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN and SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF stored in the protected production environment.
limitations: Provider configuration proof does not replace an interactive end-to-end Google user login acceptance test.
